game.title: Sheep Per Second
game.description:
Sheep Per Second is a farming incremental demo about sorting a flock at a gate. Send lambs and grown sheep down their separate paths: correctly sorted lambs grow up, expand the flock and produce the wool that pays for improvements.

Start with a manual gate, put another family member to work and build sorting machinery. Retirement and the next generation extend the farm's progression. This Godot prototype uses low-poly 3D visuals. The developer collects non-identifying progression data, with an opt-out in Settings.
game.how_to_play: Watch the approaching sheep and flick the gate to separate lambs from adults. Correctly sorted lambs join the flock and eventually generate more wool. Spend wool in the shop, add help and automate sorting, then continue through retirement and the family's next generation.
game.controls:
Flick the gate – Space or mouse click
Open shop – S
Open statistics – Tab
Open settings – Esc
Pan the shop tree – Drag
Zoom the shop tree – Mouse wheel
Fit the shop tree – Double-click
game.tips:
Prioritize accurate sorting: each correctly handled lamb can grow the wool-producing flock.
Check the shop as wool accumulates to find help and automation.
The shop tree supports zooming and a double-click fit view if an upgrade is hard to find.
game.features:
Manual sheep-sorting gate
Wool-funded farm upgrades
Family helpers and sorting automation
Retirement and generational progression
Low-poly 3D presentation
Free browser demo made with Godot
Optional progression telemetry can be disabled in Settings
game.short_description: Sort lambs, grow a wool business and hand an increasingly automated sheep farm to the next generation.

game.title: Burst Blackjack
game.description:
Burst Blackjack changes the stakes of a blackjack hand: losses add penalty points and alter the character's appearance through several transformation stages. The first side to reach 50 penalty points loses the match.

A blackjack inflicts a 21-point penalty on the opponent, while going bust immediately converts the overage into penalties. The dealer draws one card at a time and character reactions change as the match progresses. English and Japanese are available. The game includes weight-gain and body-transformation themes, with illustrations credited to Just_look_ing.
game.how_to_play: Use the game's hit and stand choices to play each hand. Keep track of the custom penalty total as well as the cards: losses cause transformations, a blackjack applies 21 penalty points to the opponent, and busting immediately adds the excess. Avoid being the first to accumulate 50 penalty points.
game.controls: Use the on-screen blackjack choices. See the original itch.io page and in-game prompts for control details; no keyboard shortcuts are specified on the page.
game.tips:
Track penalty totals between hands, because 50 penalties lose the match.
Account for the immediate penalty from busting before choosing another card.
A blackjack's 21-point penalty can make a large difference late in a match.
game.features:
Custom blackjack penalty rules
50-point match limit
21-point penalty for a blackjack
Staged character appearance changes
Changing character reactions
English and Japanese options
Free browser version
game.short_description: Play custom-rule blackjack where losing points trigger character transformations and 50 penalties end the match.

game.title: Scrap Yard Tycoon
game.description:
Scrap Yard Tycoon starts with a rundown yard, R500 and one rusty hatchback. Inspect wrecks, remove valuable parts and crush the stripped shells for cash. Engines, wheels, batteries, doors and other components disappear from the hand-drawn top-down cars as you dismantle them.

Reinvest in tools, storage, machinery and workers while expanding from two bays to ten. The developer lists 14 vehicles, rolling contracts, random market events, 18 achievements and 12 yard ranks. Autosave and offline worker earnings support short sessions. The browser game supports desktop and mobile controls without ads or accounts, according to the developer.
game.how_to_play: Complete the interactive tutorial, select a wreck and inspect it for condition and value. Remove parts to sell, check trunks for finds and crush the remaining shell. Use the proceeds to acquire more wrecks, improve tools, expand storage and bays, and hire workers. Work toward contracts, yard ranks and the vehicle catalogue.
game.controls:
Select a car or remove a glowing part – Click or tap
Pan – Drag
Zoom – Scroll or pinch
Inspect – E
Remove next part – R
Strip all – A
Crush – C
Next car – Tab
Sell all – S
Open panels – M / U / Y / I / G
Pause – P
Close – Esc
game.tips:
Inspect a wreck before stripping it to learn its condition and potential value.
Remove worthwhile parts and check the trunk before crushing the shell.
Expand storage and bays alongside your dismantling capacity.
Workers can earn while you are away, so hiring supports progress between sessions.
game.features:
Part-by-part vehicle dismantling
Hydraulic crushing and scrap sales
14 vehicles to discover
Seven upgrade lines and four yard expansions
Workers with offline earnings
Rolling contracts and random events
18 achievements and 12 yard ranks
Mouse, keyboard and touch controls
Browser autosave
No ads or account required, as stated by the developer
game.short_description: Turn R500 and a rusty hatchback into a salvage business by stripping parts, crushing shells and expanding the yard.

game.title: Boristan (playtest)
game.description:
Boristan (playtest) is lifeofboris's in-development simulation with driving, low-poly visuals and an open-world setting. This is a temporary free test: the developer states that the build stops working on October 20, 2026 at 20:00 EEST (17:00 UTC; October 21 at 01:00 in China).

The browser version is offered for a quick look, including on phones; the developer recommends downloads for smoother performance. Two-to-four-player co-op is available, but hosting requires the downloaded version. Browser players can join a host using a room code. Expect bugs and unfinished behavior during the test.
game.how_to_play: Open the browser build during the stated playtest window and follow its in-game prompts. Click inside the game to enable camera control. For co-op, a player with the downloaded version opens Esc → Co-op and hosts a game; other players join with the shared room code using the latest version. If performance is poor, lower Graphics quality in Settings.

The test expires on October 20, 2026 at 17:00 UTC; check availability before planning a session.

Use T while in a stuck car to return it to the road.

game.title: Idle Fantasy Shop
game.description:
Idle Fantasy Shop is an information-rich shop management game set in Latchford, on the edge of the Ashwater Marches. Gather materials, smelt metals and craft goods across six skills, then stock shelves and choose prices for customers with distinct buying habits. The current official description covers version 0.12 and hours of progression.

Build reputation with four societies, learn their tastes and complete six Ledger goals, ending at 1,000,000 Gold. At Trading level 4, the Staff Board opens Management and lets you hire six workers over time. Workshop level 10 unlocks finite Crafting Batches.

Offline simulation runs by the same deterministic rules as live play, up to 24 hours per return. English and Russian are available. Progress is stored in the browser; export a backup from Settings before clearing site data or changing devices. The developer states that the game has no ads or purchases.
game.how_to_play: Start Gather Brushwood in Gathering and turn on repeat. In Workshop, make a Reed Cord and then a Kindling Bundle. Put bundles on a shelf and open the shop; Discount helps the first goods sell. Pay the first Ledger entry at 10 Gold, then grow production, unlock skills and stock a wider selection. Use reputation and the Codex to learn what different customers want.
game.controls:
Use the on-screen skill, job, shop and Ledger controls.
Open item and customer links to consult the Codex.
Open numerical figures to inspect their breakdowns.
Export or import a save – Settings
No keyboard shortcuts are specified on the official page.
game.tips:
Follow the brushwood-to-kindling introduction to reach the first 10-Gold Ledger goal.
Watch customer information when adjusting stock and prices.
Buy the Staff Board at Trading level 4 to begin hiring workers.
Keep materials available for workers, which use the same stock as your own jobs.
Export a backup before clearing browser storage or moving to another device.
Return within 24 hours to avoid exceeding the stated offline simulation cap.
game.features:
Six production skills and job Mastery
Up to four stocked shelves
Customer groups with distinct buying behavior
Four societies and reputation rewards
Six workers unlocked through Management
Finite Crafting Batches from Workshop level 10
Six Ledger goals through 1,000,000 Gold
Deterministic offline progress up to 24 hours
English and Russian interfaces
Browser saves with export and import
game.short_description: Gather, craft and price goods for Latchford's shoppers in an idle trading game with workers and offline progress.

entries.inputTitle: ケモショタがエナドリキめてたらかわいいよね

game.title: ケモショタがエナドリキめてたらかわいいよね
game.description:
ケモショタがエナドリキめてたらかわいいよね is a Japanese-language score-attack puzzle about Te-kun working overtime. Place colored sticky notes on his desk and connect three matching notes to clear tasks and earn wages. Automatic arrivals speed up over time, and the game ends when a new automatic note has nowhere to go.

Green matches in the central 3×3 area build caffeine for a fever mode that clears notes as you sweep the cursor across them. Other colors charge skills for clearing notes, extending combos or increasing pay. A coworker can take unwanted tasks, and a name-entry leaderboard records your earnings after game over. The illustrations are hand-drawn; the developer credits AI-assisted programming and some short text.
game.how_to_play: Click to place the sticky note attached to the cursor. Connect three of the same color to clear them, chaining clears for combos and larger groups for bonuses. A blocking note shifts away from the side you click. Watch the dashed previews of automatic arrivals and keep room available. Clear green notes in the center to charge fever, and use the other colored skills to handle the growing workload.
game.controls:
Place a note – Mouse click
Pass tasks to the coworker – Click the gray dog
Clear notes during fever – Sweep the cursor across them
Use the charged red skill – Click its lower-left frame
Pause – Lower-right button or Esc
Submit earnings – Enter a name on the game-over screen
game.tips:
Watch dashed arrival previews so new automatic notes have somewhere to land.
Use the central 3×3 area for green matches to build caffeine.
The red clearing skill waits for your click, so save it for a crowded desk.
Blue, purple and yellow skills activate automatically when charged.
Hand awkward tasks to the gray dog coworker when needed.
game.features:
Three-note color matching
Increasing automatic task pressure
Combos and large-clear bonuses
Caffeine-powered cursor-clearing fever
Four colored skills
Coworker task handoff
Online earnings leaderboard
Japanese-language presentation
Mouse-based Unity browser game
game.short_description: Match three sticky notes, manage an accelerating workload and trigger caffeine-powered fever in a Japanese office puzzle.

game.title: 狐カフェ！Moreru&Moreta
game.description:
狐カフェ！Moreru&Moreta is a Japanese-language card game set in a café with fox staff. Its unusual blackjack variant rewards drink totals close to zero, rather than a conventional blackjack target. Coins earned when a character goes to the bathroom can buy upgrades on the title screen.

The developer describes two opponents and a further event tied to repeated PERFECT results. The game uses pixel-art furry characters and includes bathroom and holding-it-in humor. PC and Android are listed, with mobile support described as a recent addition.
game.how_to_play: Follow the in-game card prompts to manage drinks and aim for a total close to zero. Earn coins when a character visits the bathroom, then return to the title screen to purchase upgrades. The official page does not document every card action or special outcome.
game.controls: Use the game's on-screen card and upgrade prompts. The official page lists PC and Android support but does not specify keyboard shortcuts.
game.tips:
Aim close to zero: the stated scoring target differs from ordinary blackjack.
Check title-screen upgrades after earning coins.
Read the Japanese in-game prompts for card effects and special outcomes.
game.features:
Unusual blackjack-inspired rules
Drink totals scored near zero
Coins and title-screen upgrades
Two opponents described by the developer
Pixel-art fox-café setting
Japanese-language presentation
PC and Android browser support
Bathroom humor
game.short_description: Balance drink totals near zero and buy upgrades in a Japanese fox-café card game with bathroom humor.
